subject: CONTRACT PROPOSAL: graphics translator variants (sRGB 8-bit textures, YCbCr/XR in-shader, swizzled/pulled variants) - needs handoff of air_bridge.rs generic_plan_mode + render_pipeline.inc variant compile
body: Today generic_plan_mode returns Err('generic plan requires a translator variant') whenever the translator's BindingPlan names a VariantKey. Measured in texture_format_frontend_test: every 8-bit sRGB texture (11,31,71,81: RuntimeFact::SrgbTexture -> raw UNORM view + Metal 12-bit table decode) and every integer-format texture read through a float slot (CrossClassReads) are refused this way; XR/YCbCr in-shader forms and pulled vertex buffers would be too. Proposal (additive ABI, no struct size change): (1) Rust RenderPipelineHandle keeps the RenderPipelineDescriptor it was compiled from and a Mutex<Vec<Box<Variant>>> {key, key_hash:u64, pipeline:RenderPipeline (Device::compile_render_variant(desc,&key)), vs_spirv, fs_spirv}. (2) generic_plan_mode with allow_specialization: if plan.variant is non-empty, get-or-compile the variant, re-plan the SAME state on the variant pipeline (must yield plan.variant again, else Err), and build GenericPlan + GraphicsSpecializationPlan from the variant pipeline (layout, blobs, constants); spec.reserved[0]=1, reserved[1..2]=key_hash lo/hi (sha256 of the serde VariantKey, deterministic across processes for disk caches). (3) New FFI tegu_air_render_pipeline_variant_modules(handle,lo,hi,out{vs_ptr,vs_len,fs_ptr,fs_len}) -> pointers valid for the handle lifetime. (4) render_pipeline.inc tegu_render_generic_variant_compile: when spec->reserved[0]==1, compile those modules instead of genericVs/FsBytes (vertex-fetch compatibility check unchanged, so a pulled-vertex variant refuses explicitly); the variant key already hashes the whole spec. (5) Sidecar: sRGB raw views arrive as view_format_metal = UNORM twin (n2t_view_format_check already allows sRGB<->UNORM). Old (non-specialized) path keeps refusing. I can implement all of it (Rust + frontend + tests) if root hands me generic_plan_mode/RenderPipelineHandle in air_bridge.rs and tegu_render_generic_variant_compile in render_pipeline.inc; or encode-cpu-opus takes the Rust half and I take the frontend half. Please assign; I will not touch those regions until then.
